How to check the deficiency of vitamins and minerals in body without any tests at home.
Our body is such a magnificent machine. When things go problematic, it doesn’t really shut off without warning. Instead it sends us little signals letting us know that something needs to be fixed. All we need is to be smart enough to understand those signals. In this video, I shared 28 such signs and symptoms. Watching this video till the end, you will have a clear idea just looking at your body as to what really your body is deficient in and how to fix it easily.
